founder.title: Built by people who work in the field
founder.p1: RealizeOS comes out of Realization’s daily work in architecture, real-estate development and planning, between Israel and Portugal. Our own work runs on it.
founder.p2: We built it because scattered AI tools couldn’t carry real projects: no shared memory, no sources, no control. Now the core is free, and we help other firms put it to work.

proof.tender: Hundreds of tender documents analyzed and a comprehensive, professional tender file prepared in a foreign language in two days, for a project worth hundreds of millions of euros.
proof.arena: Arena: a residential building in Barreiro, on Lisbon’s south bank.
proof.firm: An Israeli architecture firm of about 25 people told us: “Everyone works alone. There’s no shared brain. And there’s no time.”

header.title:
Your projects run on documents.
Your AI doesn’t know them.
header.subtitle: Real-estate, architecture and construction teams decide from contracts, tenders, drawings and spreadsheets spread across many places.

layers.title: Scattered across email, Drive and WhatsApp
layers.description: Documents and decisions live in email threads, shared folders and chat groups. When it matters, nobody is sure which version is the latest.

clock.title: AI answers nobody can stand behind
clock.description: A chatbot can draft a reply to a payment request or a tender, but it can’t show where its numbers came from. When money or contracts are involved, that isn’t good enough.

users.title: The same work, rebuilt by hand
users.description: Tender requirements, quote comparisons, payment checks and investor updates are put together from scratch on every project.

painPoints.transition: RealizeOS gives every agent your firm uses one place to read from, and one set of rules to follow.

agents.title: Bring any agent
agents.subtitle: Use the AI tools your team already likes. They all connect to the same company brain through MCP, the open standard AI agents use to call outside tools.

points.b: Switch agents, or use several at once. The memory, rules and history stay with you.
Claude.ai and Claude Desktop connect with a normal sign-in. The connector gets exactly the role and projects of the person who signed in.
Approvals and the trail live in a dashboard that also works in Hebrew, right to left.

layers.title: What you keep, whatever agent you use
layers.subtitle: Four layers. Each one is something you can see.

brain.b: Your documents, decisions and rules, organized in FABRIC: plain files that belong to you. If you leave, you take them with you.

governed.b: Agents can read freely. Writing goes through the approvals you set: it waits for a person, runs once when approved, and reports back. Every answer can show its sources.
governed.see: An approval queue, a trail with sources, roles, an audit log

packs.b: Field packs for the work AEC firms repeat: tender requirements, payment checks against milestones, investor reports. In Hebrew, English and Portuguese.
packs.see: Finished documents and sheet rows, held for approval

practice.b: We find where time and money leak, set RealizeOS up with your documents, and keep it running and useful.

approvals.b: An action that needs approval waits in a queue. Once approved it runs exactly once and reports back. If something fails, nothing runs.

trail.b: Every answer can show the documents it used and the tools it ran, with numbered citations like [S1].

roles.b: Five roles, from owner to viewer. Each person can be limited to their own ventures, and the same rules apply in the dashboard, the API and every connected agent.

selfhosted.b: Runs on your server or computer, with your own model keys. Your files stay yours.

hardened.b: Recent releases were security-reviewed and hardened. Every action and sign-in goes to an audit log.

cant.title: What RealizeOS doesn’t do
cant.body: It doesn’t replace an appraiser, a lawyer or an engineer’s sign-off. It prepares the work, finds the sources and shows where every figure came from. People decide.

items.question: Is RealizeOS really free?
items.answer: Yes. RealizeOS is free to download and run. It is licensed under the Business Source License (BSL) 1.1, which lets you use it in production for your own business. The one thing you can't do is offer RealizeOS to others as a hosted or managed service. Each version becomes Apache 2.0 four years after its release, and the whole codebase on 26 March 2030 at the latest.

items.question: What do I need to get started?
items.answer: Python 3.11+, Docker (recommended), and API keys for your chosen LLM providers (Anthropic, Google AI, OpenAI, and/or Ollama for fully local inference with zero external calls).

items.question: Can I host it on my own server?
items.answer: Yes. RealizeOS is designed for self-hosting. Deploy with Docker on any VPS, cloud instance, or local machine. Your FABRIC data, event log, and SOUL identity stay on your infrastructure.

items.question: Is my data private?
items.answer: Completely. RealizeOS runs on your machine or server — local-first by design. For maximum privacy, use Ollama for fully local inference — no data leaves your network at all. The only external calls are to the LLM APIs you explicitly configure.

items.question: What is the FABRIC Entity System?
items.answer: FABRIC is the Heart of RealizeOS — a structured knowledge graph that stores your venture's entities, relationships, and context. It's portable, local-first, and yours forever. Even if you swap the dashboard, the LLM provider, or the agent runtime, your FABRIC data stays intact.

items.question: What is an Audit Sprint?
items.answer: A short, paid engagement (€495). We map where time and money leak in your firm and give you priorities and quick wins. If you go on to implementation, the €495 is credited. Implementation and ongoing operation are fixed in scope and quoted after the audit.

items.question: What is 'runtime-agnostic' architecture?
items.answer: RealizeOS uses a Runtime Adapter Layer — a registry pattern that supports any LLM backend (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, and more). You can switch providers or add new ones without touching your knowledge base or workflows. Your Heart stays the same; the Limbs are swappable.

items.question: Do I get updates?
items.answer: Yes. As an open-source project on GitHub, you get access to all updates. Pull the latest changes whenever you want — on your schedule, not ours.

items.question: Can I manage multiple businesses?
items.answer: Absolutely. RealizeOS is built for multi-venture operators. Each business gets its own FABRIC entity space with isolated agents, knowledge base, and venture voice. One engine, as many ventures as you need.
